gateways.name: Stripe
gateways.notes: Regions per stripe.com/global (checked 2026-08-04): fully supported in North/South America, Europe, Asia, Oceania; Africa is "extended network" only (via Paystack), not direct Stripe support, so Africa is deliberately omitted here. Previously live-tested per docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md and docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_REFUND_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md (July 2026) — exact date not recorded there; fill in live_tested_at once confirmed.

gateways.name: Braintree
gateways.notes: Regions per Braintree's own merchant-availability docs (checked 2026-08-04): US/Canada, Europe, Singapore/Hong Kong/Malaysia, Australia/New Zealand. No South America or Africa merchant support found. Previously live-tested per docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md and docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_REFUND_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md (July 2026) — exact date not recorded there; fill in live_tested_at once confirmed. sandbox_env_var left null pending confirmation of a genuinely side-effect-free sandbox health-check call — a client-token fetch isn't truly read-only.

gateways.name: Mollie
gateways.notes: Mollie requires the merchant itself to be based in the EEA, Switzerland, or UK (checked 2026-08-04, mollie.com) — Europe-only by design. Previously live-tested per docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md and docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_REFUND_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md (July 2026) — exact date not recorded there; fill in live_tested_at once confirmed.

gateways.name: Amazon Pay
gateways.notes: Regions per Amazon Pay's merchant-establishment country list (checked 2026-08-04): US, UK/EU, Japan. No confirmed South America/Africa/Oceania merchant support found. Per docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md, live payment testing stayed blocked on external Seller Central sandbox setup (storeId/clientId) — confirmed as a config gap, not a code defect — so live_tested_at is deliberately left unset. sandbox_env_var left null pending confirmation of a genuinely side-effect-free sandbox health-check call.

gateways.name: Adyen
gateways.notes: Adyen supports online payments in nearly 100 countries across most continents (checked 2026-08-04); coverage is limited in Sub-Saharan Africa and parts of the Middle East, so Africa is deliberately omitted here rather than overclaimed. Previously live-tested per docs/ADYEN_GATEWAY_LIVE_TESTING_AND_CSP_FIXES_JULY_2026.md and docs/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_REFUND_LIVE_TESTING_JULY_2026.md (July 2026, refund verified via signed webhook replay) — exact date not recorded there; fill in live_tested_at once confirmed. sandbox_env_var left null pending confirmation of a genuinely side-effect-free sandbox health-check call (Checkout API has no obvious no-op ping).

gateways.name: GoCardless
gateways.notes: Merchant onboarding per gocardless.com (checked 2026-08-04) covers UK/Eurozone/Sweden, US, and Canada directly; customer bank-account collection extends further to Denmark, Australia, and New Zealand. Live-testing status not yet recorded in this table.

gateways.name: Open Banking
gateways.notes: This app currently wires only the UK bank-to-bank Open Banking flow (OpenBankingPaymentService); the underlying rossaddison/openbanking-client provider registry itself spans more continents, but nothing outside the UK is actually integrated into this app yet, so "europe" is the honest scope of this row. Not a classic gateway-SDK ping candidate for automated sandbox checks; sandbox_env_var left null permanently.

gateways.name: BACS Direct Debit
gateways.notes: UK Direct Debit only — manual/file-based (BacsPaymentService), no third-party SDK/composer package and no online sandbox API to automate; sandbox_env_var left null permanently.

gateways.name: Robokassa
gateways.notes: First Asia-priority-region gateway. Direct HTTP integration against Robokassa's own JWT invoice API — no third-party SDK/composer package, per this project's supply-chain-risk decision (docs/GATEWAY_STATUS_PAGE_AUGUST_2026.md). Regions per Robokassa's own merchant docs: Russia/Belarus plus CIS Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan) and Baltic/other European countries, RUB/USD/EUR/KZT. All endpoints/formulas (CreateInvoice, OpStateExt, the Result URL callback signature) are ground-truthed against Robokassa's official OpenAPI spec (docs.robokassa.ru/openapi/robokassa.yaml) — confirmed 2026-08-04. That same spec confirms Robokassa has no sandbox at all for the Invoice API or OpStateExt (both explicitly 'testSupported: false'); the IsTest flag only applies to the legacy Merchant/Index.aspx scheme this integration doesn't use — matching what the user found by checking Robokassa's own site directly. sandbox_env_var left null permanently: there is no sandbox credential of any kind to hold. sandbox_status stays 'untested' since verification can only happen against a real merchant account's live credentials, not a free sandbox.

gateways.name: YooKassa
gateways.notes: Second Russia/CIS-market gateway (formerly Yandex.Checkout/Yandex.Kassa). Direct HTTP integration — no third-party SDK/composer package, per this project's general small-third-party-package caution. Two sources for YooKassa's official PHP SDK exist at very different versions: github.com/yoomoney/yookassa-sdk-php is a stale mirror frozen around v2.3.0 (~2022); the actively-maintained source is git.yoomoney.ru/projects/SDK/repos/yookassa-sdk-php, at v3.14.0 as of June 2026 per its CHANGELOG.md. Base URL, Basic Auth (shopId:secretKey), Idempotence-Key header, /payments, /payments/{id}, /refunds paths, payment/refund status enums, and the refund error-envelope shape were ground-truthed against the GitHub mirror first, then specifically re-checked against the current Bitbucket source for four years of possible drift — confirmed identical on both (2026-08-04). Regions carried over from Robokassa's reasoning (Russia/CIS/Baltic) as a reasonable default, not independently re-verified against YooKassa's own country-support docs this pass. YooKassa's API itself has a genuine sandbox (a free test shop with its own shopId/secretKey hitting this same production base URL) — but the user found in practice, when attempting sign-up (2026-08-04), that YooKassa requires a TIN (Tax Identification Number, i.e. a registered legal entity) even to create a shop, so an individual cannot obtain test credentials at all. Same practical KYC barrier hit with Robokassa, just for a different underlying reason (Robokassa has no sandbox API at all; YooKassa has one, but account creation itself is gated behind a TIN). sandbox_env_var still left null for now: this app's CheckGatewaySandboxesCommand assumes one secret string per gateway, and YooKassa needs a shopId+secretKey pair, so CI automation needs a small schema decision first — deliberately deferred, not an oversight. YooKassa's webhook notifications carry no cryptographic signature at all (ground-truthed via the same SDK's SecurityHelper class, re-confirmed unchanged on the current v3.14.0 source too — no signing added in four years) — authenticity relies on an IP allowlist plus a mandatory authenticated GET-back confirmation before trusting any notification, architecturally different from every other gateway in this app. sandbox_status stays 'untested' — no test-shop account currently available to verify against.

gateways.name: Paystack
gateways.notes: First Africa-region gateway. Direct HTTP integration — no third-party SDK/composer package. Paystack's own GitHub org (PaystackHQ/paystack-php) is a stale 2017 mirror of the community yabacon/paystack-php package; that package (more recently touched, 2023, 116 stars) was read directly for research purposes only, not installed, per this project's small-third-party-package caution. Base URL, Bearer-token auth, response envelope, /transaction/initialize and /transaction/verify/{reference} paths, and the X-Paystack-Signature = hash_hmac('sha512', rawBody, secretKey) webhook formula were ground-truthed directly against that SDK's real executable source (Router, RequestBuilder, Response, Event::validFor()) — confirmed 2026-08-05. Paystack's own primary docs site (paystack.com/docs) returned HTTP 403 to every fetch attempt this session (bot-protection) and could not be independently cross-checked; the /refund endpoint specifically is not covered by the SDK read at all and is built from Paystack's well-established public API shape, not a primary-source confirmation — flagged in PaystackPaymentService's own docblock. Regions: Paystack's core supported markets are Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire, Egypt, and Rwanda (per general public knowledge of Paystack's own market coverage, not independently re-verified against a primary source this session) — filling a real gap Stripe's own Africa support doesn't cover directly (Stripe's Africa reach is "extended network only", via Paystack itself). sandbox_env_var left null: like Mollie/YooKassa, Paystack's test vs live mode is just which secret key prefix (sk_test_/sk_live_) is configured against the same base URL, and the user has no registered company to create even a test Paystack account with — same practical barrier already hit with YooKassa. sandbox_status stays 'untested' for the same reason.

gateways.name: Razorpay
gateways.notes: First India-region gateway. Built against Razorpay's Payment Links API (a hosted checkout page matching this app's existing redirect pattern) via direct HTTP — Razorpay's own official razorpay/razorpay-php SDK (github.com/razorpay/razorpay-php, actively maintained, pushed 2026-07-23, not archived) was read directly for ground-truthing but deliberately not installed as a composer dependency, since its HTTP layer is built on rmccue/requests rather than the Guzzle client every other gateway here is built and tested against, and it ships no mockable test double for that HTTP layer (its own test suite is live integration tests requiring real RAZORPAY_API_KEY/SECRET credentials, confirmed via tests/TestCase.php). Base URL, HTTP Basic auth (key_id:key_secret, not a Bearer token), the /v1/payment_links and /v1/refunds paths, and both signature formulas (Payment Link callback: hash_hmac('sha256', \"{payment_link_id}|{reference_id}|{status}|{payment_id}\", keySecret); webhook: hash_hmac('sha256', rawBody, a separate webhookSecret) were ground-truthed directly against that SDK's real executable source (Api.php, Request.php, Entity.php, PaymentLink.php, Refund.php, Utility.php) — confirmed 2026-08-05. The payment_link.paid webhook event name and its payload.payment_link.entity/payload.payment.entity nesting were additionally confirmed directly against Razorpay's own current API docs (razorpay.com/docs/webhooks/payment-links/ and razorpay.com/docs/api/payments/payment-links/create-standard/, both fetched successfully this session — unlike Paystack, Razorpay's docs site was reachable). The exact X-Razorpay-Signature header name itself was not independently re-confirmed (the dedicated signature-validation doc page 404'd) — based on well-established general public knowledge instead, flagged in RazorpaySignatureService's own docblock. Refunds are per-payment, not per-payment-link, so the webhook handler stores the underlying payment id (not the payment link id) as the Merchant audit record's provider_reference specifically so refund() can use it. sandbox_env_var left null: keyId/keySecret are genuinely different per test/live mode (rzp_test_/rzp_live_) but the user has no registered company to create even a test Razorpay account with — same practical barrier already hit with YooKassa/Paystack. sandbox_status stays 'untested' for the same reason.

gateways.name: PayPal
gateways.notes: This app's broadest-reach gateway — PayPal operates in 200+ markets across every populated continent (general public knowledge, not exhaustively re-verified per-country this session; exact send/receive capability varies by country, especially in parts of Africa). Built against the Orders v2 REST API's redirect flow (POST /v2/checkout/orders, hosted approve page, POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture) via direct HTTP, not PayPal's JS Checkout SDK. PayPal's own official paypal/paypal-server-sdk (github.com/paypal/PayPal-PHP-Server-SDK, actively maintained, pushed 2026-06-05, not archived — its two predecessors are both archived/deprecated) was read directly for ground-truthing but deliberately not installed, same reasoning as Razorpay: its HTTP layer is APIMatic-generated code on apimatic/unirest-php, not the Guzzle client this app's gateways are tested against, with no mockable test double. Base URL (api-m.paypal.com live / api-m.sandbox.paypal.com sandbox — genuinely a different base URL, not just a different credential, unlike every other gateway here), the OAuth2 client-credentials token flow (POST /v1/oauth2/token), and the create/capture/refund endpoint paths were ground-truthed directly against that SDK's real executable source (ClientCredentialsAuthManager.php, OAuthAuthorizationController.php, OrdersController.php, PaymentsController.php) — confirmed 2026-08-05. The verify-webhook-signature request shape, the PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event name, and the capture resource's invoice_id field were additionally confirmed directly against PayPal's own current developer docs (developer.paypal.com, reachable this session, unlike Paystack's). Not independently re-confirmed: the exact verification_status/SUCCESS response field from verify-webhook-signature (the fetched docs page showed the request shape but not a sample response) — based on well-established general public knowledge instead, flagged in PaypalPaymentService's own docblock. Architecturally unique in this app: paypalComplete() is not purely read-only — PayPal requires a server-to-server capture call after the customer approves, since no money moves automatically; this action performs that required capture but still leaves marking the invoice paid in this app's own database entirely to the webhook, matching the belt-and-braces convention every other gateway follows. sandbox_env_var left null: the user has no registered company to create even a test PayPal Sandbox business account with — same practical barrier already hit with YooKassa/Paystack/Razorpay. sandbox_status stays 'untested' for the same reason.
